programs.description: A woman works hard to support her family and longs to find someone she can be with. However, things worsen when she falls in love with a man only to learn he loves her sister.
Young sensation Aishwarya Majmudar joins Jay Raval to share her journey as a singer, composer and stage artist in Gujarati and Hindi music.
In 1999, five teenage boys wager with another group on a cricket match for 60 Rupees, and as they collect the money, their personal lives begin to unravel.

programs.showName: Moti Na Chowkre Sapna Man Ditha
programs.description: A woman works hard to support her family and longs to find someone she can be with. However, things worsen when she falls in love with a man only to learn he loves her sister.
Vama and Jayant attempt to secure good jobs, but things don't go their way. Later, Vama receives a call from a friend with a massive stock market tip.
After receiving the tip, Vama believes that this could be a life-changing moment. Soon, she begins planning her next move.
Coming face to face with the big bull, Vama takes her planning a bit further.
Stocks are rising, the strategy worked, and everyone is pleased, except for Vikram Ghosh. There is something that troubles him.
There are two sides to a coin, one side everyone has seen, now it's the turn of the other side.
Narsinh Mehta is a poet and saint of Gujarat, who is just like any other person facing several hardships and struggles in his life.
